Converted for HyperDR: spectral upsampling baked per film, illuminants, neutral print filters, scanner black and white levels and fitted curves resolved, grain variance tabulated, NaN wavelengths masked.
note: spektrafilm per-pixel outputs (no auto exposure, grain or spatial effects; scanner black and white correction on), linear Display P3 in and out, output gamut compression off; film density statistics of its grain on flat fields at several pixel sizes; log film exposure with halation alone across a bright square (Vision3 500T without its antihalation layer); and film exposure after in-emulsion scatter alone.
